messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - API Gateway (apigw-prod) 502/504 spike detected in ap-southeast-1. Error rate > 15% for 2m. Linked alert: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/alerts/apigw-502s

alex.s: ack, I'm on it - joining huddle. pulling metrics now. any deploys in last 30m?

maria.p: yep we rolled nginx conf change 18m ago to tweak upstream_keepalive; it's in canary at 10% then promoted. I flagged it earlier but metrics looked fine in staging.

tony.k: seeing same in logs - connections to upstream are recycling, lots of "upstream prematurely closed connection" and 502. Also seeing large number of 504 timeouts for long-poll endpoints.

alex.s: grabbing curl traces from edge LB to backend pool:
```
$ curl -v https://apigw.redwood.ai/healthcheck -H 'Host: api.redwood.ai'
* Connected to apigw (10.2.4.12) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake ok
> GET /healthcheck HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.ai
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: text/plain
* 0-byte response body
* Connection #0 to host apigw left intact
```

maria.p: logs from the nginx host show keepalive timeout set to 10s in new conf; upstreams are closing sockets after 2s from backend. We may be reaping connections too aggressively.

infra-bot: Autoscaler note: backend-pool-1 scaled from 12 -> 40 in last 8m due to CPU/RPS, but connection queue length still high.

tony.k: hypothesis: keepalive mismatch + connection pool exhaustion on backends -> lots of fresh handshakes -> backend TLS CPU spike -> timeouts -> 504. Need to reduce connection churn or scale pools and rollback keepalive change.

jane.p: customer impact report: sign-in and file uploads are failing intermittently; some customers getting 502s for API calls; CS is seeing spike in tickets. We should post interim status.

alex.s: action plan: 1) revert nginx keepalive change 2) enable upstream circuit breaker (rate limit per upstream) 3) add short-term rate limiting at edge for heavy clients 4) scale backend connection pool further. I'll run rollback if maria gives thumbs.

maria.p: rolling back keepalive change now. wf:
```bash
# on canary host
sudo cp /etc/nginx/conf.d/upstream.conf.bak /etc/nginx/conf.d/upstream.conf
sudo nginx -s reload
```

alex.s: applying rollback to service group canary -> started 3m ago. Monitoring for error rate drop.

ops-jen: FYI I'm drafting a short status page update: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting API calls in ap-southeast-1. Engineers are actively mitigating; more updates in 15 minutes." Want to wait for confirmation before posting?

tony.k: adding a temporary upstream circuit breaker via envoy route config to drop new connections when queue > 300 to protect backends. Pushing config to edge:
```json
{ "route": "/api/*", "circuit_breakers": { "max_connections": 300 } }
```

infra-bot: Envoy config push success to 4/6 edge nodes. 2 nodes pending due to restart backoff.

alex.s: good signal: error rate down from 18% -> 6% over last 90s in canary region. Latency trending down.

jane.p: CS: initial ticket volume doubled; we've posted interim status. Requesting ETA to full remediation for customers.

maria.p: continuing rollback to remaining nodes. Doing a rolling reload with health-check gated restarts to avoid taking down more capacity.

tony.k: increased backend pool to 80 instances (short-lived spot nodes) to absorb incoming connections. Monitoring TLS CPU.

alex.s: after rollback + circuit breaker + scale, 5xxs now ~1.5% cluster-wide, ap-southeast-1 down to 0.8%. I'm going to keep the incident open until stable for 30m and then run postmortem.

jane.p: posted update to status page and customers; will coordinate follow-ups for customers with high error volume. :white_check_mark:

ops-jen: request for oncall handoff at 2025-07-29T08:30Z -> I'll hand to afternoon team once stable.

maria.p: note for postmortem: root cause likely a misconfigured keepalive + promotion without full integration test for upstream keepalive mismatch; also we should add a pre-promotion traffic test that measures connection churn and TLS CPU.

alex.s: agreed. I'll capture logs, config diff, and relevant metrics into the incident board. tagging for SRE postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation active, error rate < 2% for 10m. Next update at 1738210200 or when status changes.

alex.s: closing loop - leaving channel but will be on-call for follow-up. If anything spikes ping me directly.

maria.p: :thumbsup: continuing health checks.

tony.k: adding runbook task: add automated check that upstream keepalive <= backend timeout during CI.

ops-jen: handoff complete — transitioning to monitoring. Closing incident channel when we hit 30m stable.

infra-bot: Note: create incident ticket INC-2025-1738206420 for postmortem and tracking.
